    nodes=sorted(set().union(*(m for m,b in items)) if items else [])
    ni={x:i for i,x in enumerate(nodes)}
    n=len(items)
    # Preserve original item identities for mask
    order=sorted(range(n),key=lambda i:-items[i][1])
    vals=[items[i][1] for i in order]
    masks=[sum(1<<(6*ni[x]) for x in items[i][0]) for i in order]
    cap=[caps[x] for x in nodes]
    # no cap clamp needed <=22
    # suffix benefit
    suf=[0]*(n+1)
    for i in range(n-1,-1,-1): suf[i]=suf[i+1]+vals[i]
    # node users item indices sorted ascending, corresponding vals desc globally
    users=[[] for _ in nodes]
    for i,(it,val) in enumerate(zip(masks,vals)):
        for x in items[order[i]][0]: users[ni[x]].append(i)
    # for each node each depth: start index in users >=depth, tail sums from end
    starts=[]; tails=[]
    for us in users:
        st=[]
        p=0
        for d in range(n+1):
            while p<len(us) and us[p]<d: p+=1
            st.append(p)
        starts.append(st)
        # tail[j]=sum vals[us[j:]]
        tl=[0]*(len(us)+1)
        for j in range(len(us)-1,-1,-1): tl[j]=tl[j+1]+vals[us[j]]
        tails.append(tl)
    best=-1; bestc=10**9; bestmask=0
    used=[0]*len(nodes)
    curc=0
    calls=0
    def bound(i, cur):
        # suffix sum minus max required exclusion
        loss=0
        for k,us in enumerate(users):
            st=starts[k][i]
            U=len(us)-st
            allowed=cap[k]-used[k]
            if U>allowed:
                need=U-allowed
                l=tails[k][len(us)-need]
                if l>loss: loss=l
        return cur+suf[i]-loss
    def rec(i,cur,cnt,mask):
        nonlocal best,bestc,bestmask,calls
        calls+=1
        if i==n:
            if cur>best or (cur==best and cnt<bestc):
                best=cur;bestc=cnt;bestmask=mask
            return
        ub=bound(i,cur)
        if ub<best: return
        if ub==best:
            # lower bound items to add best-cur
            need=best-cur
            s=0;t=0
            while t<n-i and s<need:
                s+=vals[i+t];t+=1
            if cnt+t>=bestc:
                return
        # include if fits
        m=masks[i]
        ok=True
        for x in items[order[i]][0]:
            k=ni[x]
            if used[k]>=cap[k]:ok=False;break
        if ok:
            for x in items[order[i]][0]: used[ni[x]]+=1
            rec(i+1,cur+vals[i],cnt+1,mask | (1<<order[i]))
            for x in items[order[i]][0]: used[ni[x]]-=1
        rec(i+1,cur,cnt,mask)
    rec(0,0,0,0)
    if verbose: print('calls',calls,'n',n,'dims',len(nodes))
    return best,bestc,bestmask,calls
